personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean with Premium SaaS Structuring
personality_one_liner: A dense, precise, and highly tactile project showcase blending Apple HIG's clarity with Linear's technical elegance.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical rhythm mimicking Notion/Linear. Tightly grouped metadata inside cards with larger padding around the structural blocks.

do's: Use frosted glass on the sticky tab bar and sticky screen headers when content scrolls behind.
Use glass over the dark hero background to float the project CTA.
Apply glass blur to bottom-sheet handles/headers.
dont's: Avoid heavy blur that obscures text; always pair with a translucent tinted base (>= 70% opacity of surface).
Do not use glass on simple list items or tech tags.

screens.name: Splash & Onboarding
screens.purpose: Introduce the platform with the blue rounded-square 'P' mark and clear premium SaaS framing.
screens.layout: Full-bleed abstract background with a gradient scrim ensuring high contrast. Centered minimal typography. Primary CTA pinned at the bottom.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Discover Projects & Meet Talent via premium horizontal-scroll carousels.

states.loading: Skeleton cards mimicking 12px rounded Linear-style blocks.

screens.layout: Hero banner with dark tech-abstract background, gradient scrim (top->bottom), headline 'Discover Real Projects', subtitle, and two buttons. Below hero: Horizontal scroll sections ('Built by BBD Select Students', Featured Projects, Latest Projects, Featured Graduates). Cards use 1px hairline border, subtle shadow.

screens.name: Projects
screens.purpose: Extensive project directory with instant search and multi-select filtering.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty folder + 'No projects match your filters.'

screens.layout: Sticky header with search bar and horizontal scrolling filter chips (Apps, Websites, Graphic Design, etc.). Grid/list of project cards below. Cards contain cover image, small logo overlapping edge, project title, and compact tech tags.

screens.name: Project Details
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a project with gallery and interactive demo links.
screens.layout: Edge-to-edge cover image with vertical gradient scrim at bottom. Logo floats over the seam. Content uses Notion-style block rhythm: Description, Tech Stack chips, Image Gallery carousel, floating CTA for 'Live Demo / Download'. Development team list with mini avatars.

screens.name: Graduates
screens.purpose: Directory of verified graduates available for work or networking.

states.loading: List of skeleton avatars and text blocks.

screens.layout: Sticky search bar. List of graduate profile cards. Each card has an avatar (photo), name, professional headline, and a prominent 'Available for Work' badge (lime green). Secondary CTA 'View Profile'.

screens.name: Graduate Profile (Editable & View)
screens.purpose: Showcase a graduate's skills, links, resume, and owned projects.

states.empty: Guest state: 'No Graduate Profile Found' with 'Explore BBD Select' and 'Create Profile' buttons.

screens.layout: Cover banner image, overlapping profile image. Name and headline. About text, list of skill chips, experience, social/github links, and resume download. Section below lists their specific projects. Editable state adds subtle 'Edit' icons to sections.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Manage app preferences like dark mode, language, terms, and logout.
screens.layout: Standard iOS HIG grouped list format with 1px dividers, clear iconography per row, and toggles for preferences.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the 'iOS-Native Clean with Premium SaaS Structuring' guideline. This is essentially an Apple HIG foundation (large tap targets, readable scale, clear hierarchy) fused with a Linear/Notion visual language (12px/16px radii, 1px subtle borders, precise typography).

Do not use colorful generic UI or heavy gradients. Stick strictly to the Navy/Lime palette. The brand navy (#0A1330) acts as the primary anchor, and Lime (#C8D62B) is used selectively for primary actions, active states, and 'Available for Work' badges.
Implement a strict Light Mode and Dark Mode as instructed. In dark mode, shift the background to near-black (#050914) and use the brand Navy (#0A1330) as elevated surface cards.

For the hero banner and any image-based background, you MUST implement the gradient scrim pattern (Layer 0 image -> Layer 1 top-to-bottom transparent to >= 70% surfaceInverse linear gradient -> Layer 2 text). Zero tolerance for illegible text on images.
Project cards and profile cards should feel like structured 'blocks' (1px hairline borders, subtle or zero shadows, clear internal spacing). Avoid rounded bubble-like designs.
For horizontal carousels on the Home screen, ensure they don't break the layout. Cards should have consistent width and snap to edges natively.
Keep typography tight and disciplined. Use Geist for all text to achieve that precise, technical SaaS feel. Cap font weights at 500.
Do NOT alter the 'blue rounded-square P mark' logo. It must be used exactly as is for branding, auth, and splash screens.
